title: Region Composition Contract
description: Optional `composition` block on an element-manifest region (mirrored from blueprint layout.regions[].composition). Splits a region into a background plane (asset/chart/map) + foreground DOM overlays with z-order. verify_elements.py asserts every declared foreground overlay renders as an addressable [data-element] DOM node, geometrically inside the background, and stacked above it — the deterministic ANTI-SWALLOW gate: a foreground baked into the background bitmap has no addressable node and fails. (The orthogonal VLM count-recount of rev2 F2 is the producer-side automation; this is the consumer-side gate.) Optional and additive: a region without `composition` is verified exactly as before.

background.description: The background plane. inpaint-clean means the foreground was painted out of the asset (CV inpaint, automating the hand-made *-clean.png) so the foreground does not appear twice.

asset_policy.description: inpaint-clean: produce the background with foreground regions inpainted out. crop: plain rectangle crop (only valid when there is no foreground). none: background is DOM/CSS, not an asset.

asset_element_id.description: data-element id of the background asset node (img/canvas/svg/video). Verified to exist and be an image/chart-host node, and to be distinct from every foreground id.

library.description: Renderer for chart/map/3d backgrounds, e.g. echarts/leaflet/three.

generated_asset_path.description: Workbench-relative cleaned asset produced by materialize_composition_assets.py.

foreground.description: DOM overlays floating above the background, in ascending z order. Each MUST render as an addressable [data-element] node — never baked into the background asset. Empty array asserts 'this region has no foreground' (crop policy allowed).

component_id.description: data-element id of the overlay; must be component-track DOM (text/control/card...), not an asset.

z.description: Stacking order above the background (background is z=0).

examples._comment: trip-route-map: a map background with the 'Bookings 7/10' card floating on top. The overlay is a separate DOM node (not baked into trip-map.png); the background is the inpaint-cleaned map asset.
examples.name: trip-route-map
